pages.title: A Compooper Full of Urine
pages.text: Right-click a default toilet while holding an empty compooper to collect urine.$(br2)You can also pour a urine bucket into an empty compooper.

pages.title: Distillation
pages.text: Place a urine compooper above a lit campfire and wait. It distills into a water compooper.$(br2)This also produces urea.
